from pathlib import Path
from openpyxl import load_workbook

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/325-44/1_325-44_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/325-44_0_22b6f603/1_325-44_output.xlsx"

def convert_token(tok):
    """Match the existing Output pattern: numeric-looking IDs are stored as numbers."""
    if tok is None:
        return None
    s = str(tok)
    stripped = s.strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", stripped):
        return int(stripped)
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?(?:\d+\.\d*|\d*\.\d+)", stripped):
        return float(stripped)
    return s

def parse_filter(filter_text):
    result = {}
    if filter_text is None:
        return result
    text = str(filter_text).strip()
    if text.endswith(";"):
        text = text[:-1]
    # Match clauses such as ("orgId" = "LIM") or ("contextId" IN LIST 98,122)
    pattern = re.compile(r'\(\s*"([^"]+)"\s*(=|IN\s+LIST)\s*(.*?)\s*\)', re.IGNORECASE)
    for key, op, val in pattern.findall(text):
        val = val.strip()
        if op.strip().upper() == "=":
            if len(val) >= 2 and val[0] == '"' and val[-1] == '"':
                val = val[1:-1]
            result[key] = [val]
        else:
            parts = []
            for part in val.split(","):
                part = part.strip()
                if len(part) >= 2 and part[0] == '"' and part[-1] == '"':
                    part = part[1:-1]
                parts.append(part)
            result[key] = parts
    return result

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws_in = wb["Input"]
ws_out = wb["Output"]

headers = ["wtype_id", "name", "status", "orgId", "careType", "specialtyId", "contextId"]

# Clear exactly the allowed output range first, then refill it.
for row in ws_out.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=10, min_col=1, max_col=7):
    for cell in row:
        cell.value = None
        cell.number_format = "General"

for col_idx, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    ws_out.cell(row=1, column=col_idx).value = h
    ws_out.cell(row=1, column=col_idx).number_format = "General"

# Detect columns from the Input header row.
input_headers = {ws_in.cell(1, c).value: c for c in range(1, ws_in.max_column + 1)}
required = ["wtype_id", "name", "status", "filter"]

out_rows = []
for r in range(2, ws_in.max_row + 1):
    if all(ws_in.cell(r, input_headers[h]).value is None for h in required if h in input_headers):
        continue

    wtype_id = ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["wtype_id"]).value
    name = ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["name"]).value
    status = ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["status"]).value
    fdata = parse_filter(ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["filter"]).value)

    org_vals = fdata.get("orgId", [None])
    care_vals = fdata.get("careType", [None])
    spec_vals = fdata.get("specialtyId", [None])
    context_vals = fdata.get("contextId", [None])

    # Preserve source/input ordering; specialtyId varies outside contextId as in the example.
    for org in org_vals:
        for care in care_vals:
            for spec in spec_vals:
                for ctx in context_vals:
                    out_rows.append([
                        wtype_id,
                        name,
                        status,
                        org,
                        care,
                        convert_token(spec) if spec is not None else None,
                        convert_token(ctx) if ctx is not None else None,
                    ])

# Fill only within Output!A1:G10; target allows up to 9 data rows.
for out_r, values in enumerate(out_rows[:9], start=2):
    for c, val in enumerate(values, start=1):
        cell = ws_out.cell(row=out_r, column=c)
        cell.value = val
        cell.number_format = "General"

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
